messages:
Sam (Design): quick design check — we have an icon-only button in the compact table row that's visually ~20px, but we're keeping a 36px hit area via padding. On mobile that shrinks vertical rhythm. Also noticed toasts sometimes show between the sticky header and a stacked modal on mobile — looks like they float in the wrong layer. thoughts?

Priya (Frontend): we intentionally keep the visual small to save space, but agree the touch target needs to be >=44px on mobile. two ways: increase row height (ugh) or use invisible hit padding (we already do). negative margins could maintain row height, but it gets fiddly with borders.

Yvonne (Accessibility): accessibility note — mobile touch targets should be >=44px. if the visible control is smaller, ensure a strong visible focus ring and that the hit area is discoverable. also make sure icon buttons have aria-labels.

Jon (Product): users have reported missed taps on small icons in the console — that's a product regression. i'd rather be conservative: enforce visible 44px on mobile for important controls. regarding toasts — they appearing between header and modal is a bug; looks unpolished.

Priya (Frontend): digging into portal behavior — our toast component portals to the nearest stacking container. on mobile the modal creates a new stacking context, so toasts end up inside modal wrapper. current z tokens: --z-toast: 900, --z-modal: 1000. but since it's a child, CSS stacking context wins. quick fix: always portal to document.body and add data attribute to pick toast z via global variable.

Sam (Design): design preference: toasts should not float above modals that contain focusable actions. if modal is open and has primary actions, keep toasts behind the modal overlay (or convert to an inline banner inside the modal). for non-interactive toasts it's fine to show above header but below modal backdrop.

E2E Bot: flaky test: toast-dismiss-e2e intermittently fails on iOS small view when toast mounts inside modal (timeout waiting for click).

Priya (Frontend): proposal (small PR): 1) enforce min 44px hit area for icon buttons via utility class (calc padding) 2) ensure icon buttons always have aria-label enforced by linter 3) portal to root for toasts and add --z-toast-layer token; add variant for 'toast-over-modal' boolean 4) add an integration test to catch toast portal regressions. snippet: ```css
.icon-btn { --icon-size: 20px; padding: calc((44px - var(--icon-size)) / 2); }
```

Yvonne (Accessibility): +1 to aria-label linter. also ensure toasts use aria-live=polite when non-interactive and role=status. for toasts with actions use aria-atomic and focus-management guidance.

Sam (Design): i'll do two quick figma frames: 1) maintain visual compactness but show clear hit boundary on touch 2) visually expand in mobile only. i'll drop links.

Priya (Frontend): i'll open the PR after lunch. will include the portal change and a small css token rename suggestion: change token name 'compact-row' to 'row-compactness' to avoid confusion with density tokens.

Jon (Product): sounds good. let's gate the wide rollout until we run a quick mobile click-rate A/B (2 weeks). :thumbsup:

Sam (Design): linking figma comps (will post) and will add copy tweaks for toast actions so they remain short. thanks all!
